items.name: Adarsh Ranjan
items.quote: Education has the power to transform lives. Our goal is to make expert guidance accessible to every aspiring student, bridging the gap between talent and opportunity.
items.subQuote:
When I was in 10+2, I witnessed many of my friends struggle due to the lack of proper career counselling. Because of incorrect or incomplete guidance, they made mistakes while choosing their career paths. That experience made me realize how important the right guidance at the right time is for a student’s future.
From that moment, career counselling became not just a profession for me, but a dream and a responsibility—to help students choose the best possible career option through honest and personalized guidance.
Today, with over 7+ years of experience in the career counselling field, I am proud to share that I have helped 1000+ students choose the right career and college. We strongly believe that financial challenges should never stop a child from completing their education, which is why our team also supports students in securing scholarships, education loans, and credit card facilities.
At present, RightPath Saarthi stands as one of the young and trusted career counselling teams, committed to guiding students and parents with transparency, care, and long-term vision.
I am confident that in the coming years, RightPath Saarthi will continue to help many more students build a secure and successful future.
Because for us — “Your Dream, Our Goal!!”
Warm Regards,
Director
RightPath Saarthi.
